output.answer_markdown: No. The Q2 2023 10-Q describes no new spin-off of a large business segment. The only spin-off it mentions is the earlier Upjohn Business, which was spun off on November 16, 2020 and combined with Mylan to form Viatris [3]. Pfizer still expects about $700 million of separation costs for Upjohn, roughly 90% of which had been incurred through Q2 2023 [40]. The current strategic moves are an acquisition and a small divestiture. Pfizer is acquiring Seagen for about $43 billion [12]. In July 2023 it agreed to sell its early-stage rare disease gene therapy portfolio to Alexion for up to $1 billion plus royalties [40].
